configuration_note: Official macOS CLI setup --check ignores ZELLIJ_CACHE_DIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME for cache (reported Library/Caches); incidental runtime cache allowed. Config/socket dirs workspace-local, no user config changed.
supervisor_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
LAB=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd "$LAB/.." && pwd)
cleanup() {
 . "$ROOT/tests/zellij-test-safety.sh"
 zellij_safe_delete "$FM_ZELLIJ_SESSION"
 status=$?
 printf 'named zellij_safe_delete session=%s status=%s\n' "$FM_ZELLIJ_SESSION" "$status" >> "$ZELLIJ_EVIDENCE/zellij-cleanup.log"
 zellij list-sessions --short --no-formatting >> "$ZELLIJ_EVIDENCE/zellij-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || true
 rm -rf "$LAB"
 [ ! -e "$LAB" ] && printf 'disposable download, binary, driver, marked lab and config removed\n' >> "$ZELLIJ_EVIDENCE/zellij-cleanup.log"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
python3 "$LAB/hold.py"
local_config:
show_release_notes false
show_startup_tips false
session_serialization false
pane_frames false
web_server false
web_sharing "disabled"
default_mode "locked"
